name: Ammo Info in Actions Menu
teaser: A very simple mod to give more information about the ammo you are looking at in-raid with things like Caliber, Penetration, and Damage.
description_html:
The config.json file contains the following options

ShowDamage - true/false - Switch to false to hide the damage line for the tooltip

ShowCaliber - true/false - Switch to false to hide the caliber line for the tooltip

ShowPenetration - true/false - Switch to false to hide the penetration line for the tooltip

Please report any bugs or suggestions through Github Issues
